```{r function}
# The function is set up for cleaning daily air pollution data from a CSV file.
# Arguments:
#  filepath: Path to the input CSV file.
#  o3_unit: Output unit for O3 ("ppm" or "ppb"); defaults to "ppm".
# Returns:
#  A cleaned tibble with one row per day and daily mean concentrations.

clean <- function(filepath, o3_unit = "ppm") {
  
# Read in data
  data <- read.csv(filepath)
  
# Rename the pollutant concentration columns
  data <- data |> 
    rename(
       CO_max = Daily.Max.8.hour.CO.Concentration,
      PM25_mean = Daily.Mean.PM2.5.Concentration,
      O3_max = Daily.Max.8.hour.Ozone.Concentration
    ) |> 
# Format the date variable
    mutate(Date = mdy(Date)) |> 
# Remove duplicated rows
    distinct()
  
# Set any measured concentration that is negative to zero
pollutants <- c("CO_max", "PM25_mean", "O3_max")
for (i in pollutants) {
  data[, i] <- ifelse(data[, i] < 0, 0, data[, i])
}
  
# Calculate the average concentration
data <- data |> 
  group_by(Date) |> 
  mutate(
    CO_max = mean(CO_max, na.rm = TRUE),
    PM25_mean = mean(PM25_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    O3_max = mean(O3_max, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  distinct()

# Convertible O3 units
if (o3_unit == "ppb") {
  data <- data |>
    mutate(
      O3_max = O3_max * 1000,
      units_O3 = "ppb"
    )
}

  return(data)
}


# Clean each year's data
cleaned_2018 <- clean(here::here("data", "AQ_2018.csv"))
cleaned_2019 <- clean(here::here("data", "AQ_2019.csv"))
cleaned_2020 <- clean(here::here("data", "AQ_2020.csv"))

# Combine to a single dataset
pollution_data <- bind_rows(
  cleaned_2018, cleaned_2019, cleaned_2020
) |>
  arrange(Date)
```

```{r tables, echo=FALSE}
# Create tables
library(gt)
pollutants <- c("CO_max", "PM25_mean", "O3_max")

table_2018 <- tibble(
  Pollutant = c("CO (ppm)", "PM2.5 (ug/m3 LC)", "O3 (ppm)"),
  Minimum = sapply(cleaned_2018[pollutants], min, na.rm = TRUE),
  Maximum = sapply(cleaned_2018[pollutants], max, na.rm = TRUE)
) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(Minimum, Maximum), decimals = 3) |>
  tab_header("Table 1. Minimum and maximum daily pollutant concentrations in 2018")
table_2018


table_2019 <- tibble(
  Pollutant = c("CO (ppm)", "PM2.5 (ug/m3 LC)", "O3 (ppm)"),
  Minimum = sapply(cleaned_2019[pollutants], min, na.rm = TRUE),
  Maximum = sapply(cleaned_2019[pollutants], max, na.rm = TRUE)
) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(Minimum, Maximum), decimals = 3) |>
  tab_header("Table 2. Minimum and maximum daily pollutant concentrations in 2019")
table_2019

table_2020 <- tibble(
  Pollutant = c("CO (ppm)", "PM2.5 (ug/m3 LC)", "O3 (ppm)"),
  Minimum = sapply(cleaned_2019[pollutants], min, na.rm = TRUE),
  Maximum = sapply(cleaned_2019[pollutants], max, na.rm = TRUE)
) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(Minimum, Maximum), decimals = 3) |>
  tab_header("Table 3. Minimum and maximum daily pollutant concentrations from January to April 2020")
table_2020
```

```{r plot1}
#  CO and O3 by month
plot1_data <- pollution_data |>
  mutate(
  Month = factor(
    month(Date),
    levels = 1:12,
    labels = month.abb
  )
) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(CO_max, O3_max),
    names_to = "Pollutant",
    values_to = "Concentration"
  ) |>
  group_by(Month, Pollutant) |>
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(Concentration)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Lower = Mean - 1.96 * SD / sqrt(n),
    Upper = Mean + 1.96 * SD / sqrt(n)
  )


ggplot(monthly_data, aes(x = Month, y = Mean, color = Pollutant)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Pollutant, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CO_max" = "#555555", "O3_max" = "darkviolet"),
                     labels = c("CO_max" = "CO", "O3_max" = "O3")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Mean CO and O3 Concentrations",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Mean Concentration (ppm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_blank())
```
CO and O3 are displayed in separate panels with independent y-axis scales because their concentrations differ substantially in magnitude. This allows the monthly patterns and confidence intervals of both pollutants to be clearly visualized.

```{r plot2}
plot2_data <- pollution_data |>
  mutate(
    Month = factor(
    month(Date),
    levels = 1:12,
    labels = month.abb
  ),
    Year = factor(year(Date))
  ) |>
  group_by(Year, Month) |>
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(PM25_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(plot2_data, aes(x = Month, y = Mean, color = Year, group = Year)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Mean PM2.5 Concentrations by Year",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Mean PM2.5 Concentration (µg/m³)",
    color = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
